items.name: Lexington Summer 2017

venue.name: Lexington High School
venue.details: Will take place in both cafeterias, follow signs

items.information: This is the second two-day competition in Lexington. There is a **150** competitor limit for this competition. To get to the competition you will enter the main doors out front by Waltham Street and follow the signs to the cafeterias. Please note that you are not required to attend both days, and all rounds of each event will occur on one of the days. **Registration will close either when the 150 competitor limit is reached or on June 17, 2017 at 7:00pm EDT, whichever occurs first.**

items.information: La organización se reserva el derecho de limitar el numero de acompañantes por competidor, si ello fuera necesario para mantener el orden en el espacio del campeonato. Se intentará, en la medida de lo posible, no limitar el número de competidores que puedan asistir al campeonato. Si hubiera que hacerlo, será anunciado claramente en esta página antes de cerrar el registro, tras lo cual, no serán admitidos más competidores.
